cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX

def run(case, evs):
    c = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'], 0)
    c.replay(evs)
    return c

print('=== blocked DATA does not request a repeat ===')
case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=3, words=1, capacity=1, start=0)
full = [{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
c = run(case, full + [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1}])   # blocked
st = c.state_list()
print('blocked:', st[24], 'txack', st[21], 'packets', c.packets)
c = run(case, full + [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1}, {'op':'flush'}])
print('after flush: packets', c.packets, 'txack', st[21], '(no repeat expected: 4 acks + 4 data = 8)')
c = run(case, full + [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':0}, {'op':'flush'}])   # duplicate
print('duplicate then flush: packets', c.packets, '(expect 9: 8 + repeated ack)')

print()
print('=== failed retransmission does not queue a continuation ===')
case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=1, words=1, capacity=1, start=0)
full = [{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
c = run(case, full + [{'op':'budget','n':1},{'op':'retry','rank':2},
                      {'op':'budget','n':-1},{'op':'retry','rank':2}])
st = c.state_list()
print('packets', c.packets, 'txdata', st[20], 'S', st[6:10], 'A', st[10:14], 'fail', st[29])
print('expect: 4 ack + 4 data + 1 retransmit (budget1) + 1 retransmit (retry2) = 10')
# also verify first retry only sent one
c = run(case, full + [{'op':'budget','n':1},{'op':'retry','rank':2}])
print('single budget-1 retry: packets', c.packets, 'txdata', c.state_list()[20])

print()
print('=== retirement frees but U must exceed p for every required source ===')
case = dict(primitive='allreduce', mode=3, root=0, segments=2, words=1, capacity=2, start=0)
evs = [{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
evs += [{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':1} for r in range(4)]
evs += [{'op':'budget','n':0}]
evs += [{'op':'data','rank':0,'p':1}]  # duplicate with budget 0 -> repeat req, ack fails
c = run(case, evs)
st = c.state_list()
print('b', st[0], 'U', st[14:18], 'fail', st[29], 'repeat set?', c.repeat)
EOF
